heroSub: I-FiveStar AI iklama futhi yakhe zonke izinhlobo zesofthiwe—iselula, iwebhu, ideskithophu, i-backend, ne-AI—isebenzisa ama-LLM ukuze isebenze kuzo zonke izilimi zokuhlela nezitaki zobuchwepheshe.
m1Sub: I-AI kuyo yonke idizayini, ukubhala ngekhodi ne-QA
m2Sub: Noma yiluphi ulimi, inkundla noma uhlaka
aboutLead: Siyinkampani yesoftware ye-AI enolwazi olunzulu ekuthuthukisweni okunamandla e-LLM. Siphendula izinkinga zebhizinisi zibe imikhiqizo ethembekile ngaphandle kokukhawulelwa ulimi oluthile lokuhlela, inkundla, noma isitaki sobuchwepheshe.
missionBody: Sisebenzisa i-AI nama-LLM ukukhetha amathuluzi alungile enkinga ngayinye futhi silethe kuzo zonke izitaki zobuchwepheshe.
principlesBody: I-AI isheshisa umsebenzi; onjiniyela bethu bahlala benecala ngezakhiwo, ikhwalithi, ukuphepha, kanye nemiphumela.
focusBody: Iselula, iwebhu, ideskithophu, i-backend, abenzeli be-AI, amasistimu wedatha, nokuzenzakalelayo kokuhamba komsebenzi.
productsLead: Imikhiqizo yethu ibonisa ukuthi sithatha kanjani imibono ukuyivula kuyo yonke i-AI, iselula, imibhalo, imidiya, nesofthiwe yokukhiqiza.
p1: Indlela yokusebenza ye-OCR yezincwadi eziskeniwe: khipha, sesha, fushane, i-TTS—igxile ekufihlekeni kwemininingwane ngokucutshungulwa kwendawo.
p2: Isidlali semidiya sasendaweni esisheshayo, esilula esingenazo izikhangiso kanye nolwazi olubushelelezi kuwo wonke amapulatifomu eselula.
p4: Isofthware ehambisana ne-AI yendawo ukuze ivumele ukucutshungulwa okuhlukanisiwe nezingxoxo ezimfihlakele.
p5: Yenza izithombe-skrini ze-App Store kube lula ukuzihumusha nokuzenza zihambisane nezilimi ezahlukene ukuze zithunyelwe.
p6: Ingxoxo eseduze ngokuvuma nge-Bluetooth enohumusho lwe-AI olusekhaya okukhethwayo. Alikho i-akhawunti, alikho iserba yengxoxo ephakathi.
p7: Umphathi wemapasi olazi indawo. Iveza i-coupon efanele noma ikhadi lokuba yilungu ngesikhathi ufika.
p3: Kusukela kumasistimu angaphakathi namasevisi ewebhu kuya kuselula, ideskithophu, nemikhiqizo ye-AI. Sikhetha ulimi olungcono kakhulu nesitaki senkinga ngayinye.
servicesLead: Ubunjiniyela obusheshiswe yi-LLM buguqula inkinga echazwe ngokucacile ibe isofthiwe esebenzayo ngokushesha.
s1Body: Chaza inhloso yebhizinisi, abasebenzisi, imikhawulo, nendlela yobuchwepheshe efanele.
s2Body: Sebenzisa ubunjiniyela obusizwa yi-LLM ukudizayina, ukusebenzisa, ukuhlola, nokuphindaphinda ezisekelweni zonkana.
s3Body: Sebenzisa, qapha, sebenzisa, futhi uthuthukise umkhiqizo ngokuqhubekayo.
contactLead: Sitshele ukuthi ufuna ukwakha ini. Sizophakamisa indlela esebenzayo ukusuka embonweni ukuya ekuqaleni.
